summary.text: Anna Scharf is a Republican state representative from District 23 who has represented the district since July 12, 2021 and is seeking re-election.

paragraphs.text: Anna Scharf earned a B.S. in political science from Southern Oregon University in 1990 and an M.B.A. in global management from the University of Phoenix in 2005.

Her career experience includes work as a legislative policy analyst with the Oregon House of Representatives, an office manager with Scharf Farms, Inc., and a membership manager with the Strategic Economic Development Corporation.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Agriculture and Land Use, Business and Labor, Early Childhood (vice chair) and House Rules committees.
